en: Among them, R0.69P–R0.71P reaches the positive-entry temporal-packing boundary, while R0.71Q–U gives the boundaries for conditional incidence, genuine internal-entry, second-time-jet, and finite recurrence. R0.71V–W separates the fixed zero-level trace and rules out a data-uniform complete first-row ledger. R0.71X, within a fixed-dimensional small-coupling family, reaches the one-third endpoint; R0.71Y treats selected roots; R0.71Z gives the all-root slope-mass bound and launch-inclusive floor cancellation. R0.72A localizes the strong-coupling loss to the actual observation layer, R0.72B retains exact target-row participation, and R0.72C obtains phase-uniform exact-launch \(M^{-8/3}\) and fixed-positive tail \(M^{-3}\) as the sharp algebraic scales. R0.72D, on a shifted Rudin–Shapiro family, constructs a positive-time exact root, retains the full rotational charge, and obtains a normalized complete-root ledger that does not vanish but does not diverge. R0.72E returns to a fixed-carrier Bessel family and uses quantitative negative-Sobolev action to prove that the complete-root ledger, relative to the candidate \(D^{1/3}\Lambda_1\) payment, diverges like \(R^{4/3}\). R0.72F then uses regularly varying initial-layer weights to separate the selected-root \(1/3\) threshold from the Leray payment \(1/2\) threshold and identifies the minimal critical-log boundary. R0.72G, on an exact real one-carrier lattice, uses a phase gauge, the target-row identity, and Rolle–BV reduction to prove that the complete root mass is exactly of logarithmic order, yielding critical-log complete-root sharp saturation. R0.72H proves for the mixed row a carrier-count-independent moment-resolved payment; the all-odd Rudin–Shapiro family rules out the action-only version and makes the carrier power encoded by that moment attain the same order. R0.72I proves that the separated positive \(B_AQ_*\) term cannot be absorbed physically term by term, while joint exposure and odd-carrier parity prove uniform decay of the genuine complete ledger. R0.72J completes the bipartite classification of the gcd-reduced Cayley graph, distinguishes an odd cycle from a triangle return, and proves that a common-band coherent mixed-parity cubic still decays after physical normalization. R0.72K, through a root-by-root gap norming direction, closes the complete complex-target ledger and proves that its common-band physical normalization ratio still decays uniformly. R0.72L retains the actual enstrophy contrast and critical-log action and closes, as \(R\) grows, a moderate strong-coupling window; the upper edge of the window gives only \(O(1)\), while only the little-o subwindow decays. R0.72M determines the scalar action danger window exactly and, on the complete one-carrier zero-diffusion chain, proves the Bessel action-poor benchmark and sharp logarithmic cubic law. R0.72N rules out the declared launch action-poor route on the complete dissipative chain and, from Coble–He time-dependent shear decay, derives the site's corollary \(\mathcal C_{\rm diss}\lesssim a^2\sqrt\sigma\). R0.72O reinserts this cubic into the physical ledger, obtaining an \(\varepsilon^{11/6}\) numerator and an \(R^{4/3}L_{R,\varepsilon}^2\) window; the multicarrier statement is conditional on a full-superposition ED hypothesis with a uniform constant. R0.72P closes the complete propagation gate on the fixed real-collinear static-phase 1:2 positive class, and R0.72Q then, for fixed-\(M\), arbitrary-static-phase, and \(Q_2\le1/2\), proves the two-critical-point shape gate together with an exact 1:2 caustic. R0.72R constructs a four-real-dimensional rational polydisc lying entirely outside the old weighted cone, for every \(y\ge0\) closes full-heat-path root localization, and, for \(0\le y\le1\), closes the physical \((\pi/48,144,240)\) shape contract and coefficient-uniform fixed-pattern commensurate 1:2:3 triangular affine-row enhanced dissipation; the complete four-dimensional caustic stratification is unfinished. R0.72S further takes the fixed-first-harmonic \(1{:}2{:}3\) marked incidence preimages and classifies them exactly as \(A_2,A_3,A_4,A_5\), uses determinant \(5400\) to prove, modulo constants, the restricted miniversal property, and, for the pure-second \(A_2\) and real-even \(A_3\) heat paths, gives \(4/3/2\) and \(4/2/2\) as the distinct count; the latter is transverse only within the real-even slice. This does not complete the global caustic image or prove general three-dimensional Navier--Stokes regularity. R0.72T--W fixes and closes the exact scalar A2 collision block, and R0.72X then, on a fixed physical compact set, obtains the all-start A2 path; Bloch-uniformity still belongs only to that scalar path. R0.72Y starts from Navier--Stokes and rederives the complete Fourier--Leray row, pressure factor two, Orr--Sommerfeld--Squire triangularization, and velocity recovery, then separates, by spatial norm, the scalar invariant row's forcing conclusion: standard H^-1 spacetime transfer is alpha, semiclassical H^-1 spacetime transfer is alpha^2, and the standard endpoint has no vanishing alpha gain. The exact zero-coupling lift-up shows that epsilon-only full-row closure and every-row strict contraction are FALSE. R0.72Z, on the high-gap \(q\)-graph, closes signed OS pressure and orientation-paid Squire history; R0.73A uses the hidden physical mean to close a low-gap \(X_\mu\) finite transient; R0.73B then uses exact Bloch carrier cancellation to close the complete linear velocity/Squire rows' viscous-rate physical-kinetic direct sum. Thus the low-gap vector direct sum at viscous rates is CLOSED; the complete OS--Squire A2 direct sum, sharp \(|\Lambda|\) law, nonlinear Navier--Stokes, and Clay remain OPEN. R0.73C then uses the exact cubic neutral spectrum and a validated periodic-ODE monodromy sign certificate to prove an infinite-dimensional frozen Rayleigh instability; viscous fast-time transfer remains OPEN, and super-polynomial complete-row no-go is only CONDITIONAL. R0.73D then, in the exact kinetic space, proves static vanishing-viscosity persistence of the certified inviscid spectral cluster, operator-norm convergence of the Riesz projections, and preservation of algebraic multiplicity; the general precedent belongs to Shvydkoy--Friedlander, while the complement and fast-time transfer remain OPEN. R0.73E uses fixed-positive-half-plane completeness, a relative dichotomy for the complete top cluster, and a fixed-generator Volterra argument to close logarithmic fast-time transfer; the moving-profile fixed-window problem, complete OS--Squire, nonlinearity, and Clay remain OPEN. R0.73F then uses bounded-perturbation roughness, the exact clamped profile, and a moving unstable bundle to close a fixed-window exponential lower law for one exact linear row; the finite diagnostic, complete all-row problem, nonlinearity, and Clay remain separate.

en: For one exact periodic linear Fourier row, R0.73F combines the frozen top-cluster dichotomy of R0.73E with the exact \(49d/4\) profile drift. The Lyapunov--Perron graph construction permits a noninvertible stable parabolic semigroup and gives an operator-norm lower bound \(e^{c_D|\Lambda|}\) on a fixed positive physical window. en: The archived computation compares the full propagator norm and the conorm of the finite leading block at \(N=96\), \(d_{\rm diag}=10^{-2}\), eight viscosities, and several Fourier cutoffs. The primary run took about 17.6 seconds and the independent reimplementation about 8.5 seconds; the maximum finest-step log-gain difference was \(8.84\times10^{-12}\), and the maximum normalized 48/96 cutoff difference was \(8.88\times10^{-16}\). This \(d_{\rm diag}\) is not the \(d_0\) in the existence proof; cutoff agreement is not tail control, sampled propagation is not a continuous-time theorem, and a finite leading block is not the continuum top cluster. The figure and experiment do not carry the proof of Sections 03--08.

zh: 下一门将冻结并审计一个可量化的非线性命题：明确 seed size、Sobolev topology、lifespan 与 mode-convolution remainder，检验线性 \(e^{c_D|\Lambda|}\) 放大能否在同一时间尺度内压过非线性余项。目标是给出完整 bootstrap 证明，或给出阻止闭合的否定障碍；不会预设全行估计或奇性结论。
en: The next gate will freeze and audit a quantitative nonlinear statement: specify the seed size, Sobolev topology, lifespan, and mode-convolution remainder, then test whether the linear \(e^{c_D|\Lambda|}\) amplification dominates the nonlinear remainder on the same time scale. The target is either a complete bootstrap proof or a negative obstruction to closure; no all-row estimate or singularity conclusion is presupposed.

zh: 延拓在物理区间上与精确热剖面完全一致，端点后的常值部分没有物理结论。由于负时间扰动严格为零，不稳定图在初始时刻满足 \(E^u_{\varepsilon,d}(0)=P_\varepsilon H\)，不是近似等式。
en: The extension agrees exactly with the physical profile on the physical interval, and the constant continuation after the endpoint has no physical conclusion. Because the negative-time perturbation is exactly zero, the unstable graph initially satisfies \(E^u_{\varepsilon,d}(0)=P_\varepsilon H\), not merely an approximate identity.

zh: 最初缺少共同围道左边界的统一 resolvent 数值界，图不变性与不稳定双射写得过短，端点论证有错误交叉引用，瞬时投影、动力学投影与 graph-norm Kato 边界没有充分分离，并且 all-row 边界过宽。当前文本补入 \(2K_1/\eta\) 界、固定点切分与连续性论证、正确的 (4.14) 引用和明确 claim ledger。独立解析复核结论为 FINAL PASS，且该结论条件于 R0.73B/C/E 输入。
en: The initial text lacked a uniform numerical resolvent bound on the left side of the common contour, compressed graph invariance and unstable bijectivity too much, used an incorrect endpoint cross-reference, insufficiently separated the instantaneous projection, dynamical projection, and graph-norm Kato boundary, and stated the all-row boundary too broadly. The current text adds the \(2K_1/\eta\) bound, fixed-point splitting and continuity arguments, the correct (4.14) reference, and an explicit claim ledger. The independent analytic review gives FINAL PASS, conditional on the R0.73B/C/E inputs.

zh: 左边竖线由稳定正时间与不稳定负时间 Laplace 公式控制；矩形其余三边由 dissipative factorization 与 Neumann 级数控制。固定围道可微分，得到 \(P_\varepsilon^{\rm inst}(d)\) 的统一 norm-\(C^1\) 界。这不等于未缩放 \(H^2\) graph-norm Kato transport，也没有证明瞬时投影等于移动动力学投影。
en: The left vertical line is controlled by positive-time stable and negative-time unstable Laplace formulas; dissipative factorization and a Neumann series control the other three sides of the rectangle. Differentiating the fixed contour gives \(P_\varepsilon^{\rm inst}(d)\) a uniform norm-\(C^1\) bound. This is not unscaled \(H^2\) graph-norm Kato transport, and it does not prove that the instantaneous projection equals the moving dynamical projection.

zh: kinetic vorticity norm 通过 \(U=2L^{-1/2}\) 与 \(L^2\) 精确等距。R0.73C 的认证特征值只给出 \(a\ge\sigma_*>0.17035\)；没有证明 \(\sigma_*\) 本身最右、简单或唯一。
en: Through \(U=2L^{-1/2}\), the kinetic vorticity norm is exactly isometric to \(L^2\). The certified eigenvalue from R0.73C gives only \(a\ge\sigma_*>0.17035\); \(\sigma_*\) itself is not proved rightmost, simple, or unique.

zh: Neumann 级数给出互补分解。把固定点方程在中间时刻切分，再用唯一性，可得稳定图的正向不变性和不稳定图的双射传递；后向固定点给出稍后不稳定纤维的唯一原像。秩始终等于冻结 top block 的有限正整数 \(m\)。
en: A Neumann series gives the complementary decomposition. Splitting each fixed-point equation at an intermediate time and using uniqueness yields forward invariance of the stable graph and bijective transfer of the unstable graph; the backward fixed point supplies the unique preimage in a later unstable fiber. The rank always equals the fixed positive integer \(m\) of the frozen top block.

zh: R0.73B 上界只闭合指数阶，不给出尖锐斜率

zh: R0.73F 是一条结构化精确衰减剪切流族上的实质线性不稳定定理。它允许背景振幅随 \(|\Lambda|\) 变化，也允许最大化初始方向随参数变化；没有非线性 perturbation theorem、频率级联机制、先验正则性改进或单一解奇性构造。因此它对 Clay 问题只有间接的机制价值，不构成 Clay 结论。
en: R0.73F is a substantive linear-instability theorem for a structured family of exact decaying shears. It allows the background amplitude to vary with \(|\Lambda|\) and the maximizing initial direction to vary with the parameter; it supplies no nonlinear perturbation theorem, frequency-cascade mechanism, improved a priori regularity estimate, or singularity construction for one solution. Its value for the Clay problem is therefore indirect and mechanistic, not a Clay conclusion.
